values./system/biography: Jessie Pedigrue is the settlement's mayor and the characters' patron. This profile represents the third-generation synth replica that replaces Jessie and leads the clinic attack.
values./items/@AFRnkiJq4lYph9zM/system/descript: Developed by The Institute after the Great War, Institute lasers differ in design and function from the pre-War lasers used by other factions such as the Brotherhood of Steel. Eschewing raw power for a rapid succession of beams, these lasers can lay down a searing volley of suppressive fire.
values./items/@R1cEgj76GzWZz47l/system/descript: Jessie’s synth replica is a robot. It is immune to starvation, thirst, suffocation, Poison damage, and Radiation damage. It cannot use food, drink, or other consumables, does not heal naturally, and cannot be healed with Medicine: damage to it must be repaired.
values./items/@f89CMk7Rc3bLagZJ/system/descript: Jessie’s synth replica cannot be intimidated or threatened and will either ignore or attack anyone who attempts to do so.
values./items/@zGniGCOK3g4EsDsY/system/descript: Jessie’s synth replica is immune to all diseases and never suffers their symptoms.
values./items/@w2L5Ax6zGtXLu4o1/system/descript: These synths can pass as human, and any attempt to inspect them reveals them to be human. Third-generation synths can only be identified after death by the recovery of their Synth Component. A Thirdgeneration synth posing as a known figure gains a bonus 2d20 to any rolls relating to impersonating the individual, including recalling knowledge and expressing their mannerisms.
values./items/@2TR0yWRaj0zGYgN8/system/effect: Tough Clothing, Modified Institute Laser Pistol (Photon Exciter), Wealth 2.
values./items/@A77iQQLjMKpTG4D1/system/descript: A stun baton delivers a powerful electrical discharge designed to incapacitate its target.
values./items/@adv4c65742052697/system/descript: Once per combat, add the modified Institute Laser Pistol's Fire Rate of 3 to its damage for one attack, for 6 CD total, and use Burst without spending ammunition.
values./items/@cmiI9eWQ1hYPuqv2/system/descript: Jessie’s synth replica reduces all Poison damage suffered to 0 and cannot suffer any damage or effects from poison.
values./items/@F3rxaIUI94K7YRig/system/descript: Jessie’s synth replica reduces all Radiation damage suffered to 0 and cannot suffer any damage or effects from radiation.
